com.esignal.jstandard.beans.news

Class Story

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.esignal.jstandard.beans.news.Headline
      • com.esignal.jstandard.beans.news.Story

  • public abstract class Story
extends Headline
    This class is used to send the story body and story type information back to the client using the StoryEvent using the NewsRequestListener Interfaces onResponse() method.
    Since:
    01-019-0000
    Author:
    Interactive Data
    See Also:
